reason: Routing hardening carries three reusable judgements: observability (a bounded session ledger + a first-use notice) is the right control for an agent-driven surface where an interactive confirmation would stall or rubber-stamp; a reverse routing guard must be a path-identity check on the structured surface rather than a heuristic over shell text; and per-session state (the ledger, the lifecycle generation) belongs in the closure that owns the session and is passed to the modules that need it.
